value.rationale: For an entire canonical class of 0/1 polytopes, the theorem exactly determines the integer-dilation Borsuk partition invariant and all-layer counting regularity. It gives a nontrivial closed binomial/Eulerian formula for hypersimplices and exhibits an irreducible period-two binary tetrahedron, showing a sharp structural boundary. These are natural constructions and explain global behavior, not an arbitrary parameter slice.
